QuestInfo.name: Sand Bandits' Fourth Mission
QuestInfo.0: The Sand Bandits serve the residents of #m260000000#. Now that you're a member of the Sand Bandits, you ought to receive a mission. Go see #b#p2101010##k.
QuestInfo.1: You need to defeat the monsters interfering with the food supply of Ariant.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the monsters that were interfering with the scarce supplies.

0.0: There's a new Sand Bandit mission. I want you to accept this mission. What do you say? Can you do it?

yes.0: After your help, I thought our deliveries would be smooth sailing, but now the #o2110300#s are acting up. Could you get rid of #b100 of them#k for us?
yes.1: They can't be completely exterminated, but there sure would be fewer problems in delivering the food if you decrease their numbers by that much. I leave it to you.

no.0: You are not ready to take on this mission yet...

1.0: Oh, you're back. Did you complete your Sand Bandit mission?

yes.0: Good. The delivery of food will be easier.

mob.0: Um... I think those #b100 #o2110300#s#k are still out there. It would be wonderful to cut their population down so we could get our food delivered in peace. Then the people of #m260000000# wouldn't have to worry so much about feeding their families...
